registers.name: CFR
registers.note: Table 2 (p.7): configuration register, written with A000h plus data and read with 9000h; power-up value not given (0 here; the datasheet requires writing A000h at power up, p.6)

ready.note: CFR D2 = 1: EOC, low from the end of sampling until the conversion is complete (mode 00 only, p.3)
CFR D2 = 0: INT, falls when data are ready, cleared by the following CS falling edge (td(CSL-INTH), p.3)

device.description: 2.7-5.5-V 12-bit 200-kSPS 8-channel serial ADC with 8x FIFO, CFR configuration register, CSTART and power down
device.note: tlv2544.pdf (SLAS198E, TLV2544/TLV2548) p.1 pinouts, p.3-4 terminal functions, p.5 serial interface and data formats, p.6 Table 1 command set, p.7 Table 2 CFR, p.8-10 sampling and conversion modes (Tables 3-4), p.18-19 conversion speed and power down, p.20-21 recommended operating conditions and timing, p.24 operating characteristics; FK (LCCC) pinout in tlv2548q.pdf p.1, same numbering; TLV2548-EP in tlv2548-ep.pdf

commands.name: Select analog input channel (short, 12 SCLK sampling)
commands.note: Table 1 (p.6): 0000b-0111b = channels 0-7; the conversion starts after the 16th (short sampling) or 28th (long sampling) SCLK edge (p.9)

commands.name: Select analog input channel (long, 24 SCLK sampling)
commands.note: Table 1 (p.6): 0000b-0111b = channels 0-7; the conversion starts after the 16th (short sampling) or 28th (long sampling) SCLK edge (p.9)

commands.name: SW power down
commands.note: Table 1 (p.6): 8000h powers down analog + reference; modeled as a nop (p.19: CFR retained, 20 ms warm-up with the internal reference)

commands.note: Table 1 (p.6) / p.4: the first 4 SDO bits are don't care, the CFR content is in the last 12 bits

commands.note: Table 1 (p.6) / p.24 self-test codes (800h/000h/FFFh); modeled as a conversion returning the 0 V code

commands.name: FIFO read
commands.note: Table 1 (p.6): FIFO contents shown as SDO D15-D4, D3-D0 = 0000 (the output frame of every conversion/FIFO read cycle)

pages: p.1 (pinouts), p.3-4 (terminal functions), p.5 (data formats), p.6 (initialization, start of cycle, Table 1), p.7 (Table 2 CFR), p.8 (sampling, Table 3), p.9-10 (conversion modes, Table 4), p.18 (SCLK and conversion speed), p.19 (power down), p.20-21 (recommended operating conditions and timing), p.24 (t(conv) 3.86 us max, self-test codes), p.34 (date code information); tlv2548q.pdf p.1 (FK pinout)
notModeled: analog inputs, internal 2-V/4-V reference / external reference (CFR D11-D10): every conversion returns the 0 V code (000h, unipolar straight binary, p.5)
self-test commands B000h/C000h/D000h output 800h/000h/FFFh (p.24); modeled as conversions returning the 0 V code

8-level FIFO and conversion modes 01 (repeat), 10 (sweep), 11 (repeat sweep) with the sweep sequences (CFR D4-D3) and FIFO trigger levels (CFR D1-D0): every conversion is treated as one-shot (mode 00); INT asserts after each conversion, not at the FIFO threshold, and in modes 01-11 the pin is INT regardless of CFR D2 (not modeled: it follows CFR D2)
FS (DSP frame sync) mode: input on SCLK falling edges, output on rising edges, FS-started frames; only FS = 1 (CS-framed SPI) is modeled
conversion time: internal OSC 3.86 us max (p.24); with SCLK as the conversion clock (CFR D8-D7 = 01/10/11) it is 14 x DIV / fSCLK (p.18), modeled as 0
SW power down (8000h): modeled as a nop; auto power down; 20 ms warm-up of the internal reference

CSTART extended sampling: sampling from CSTART falling (CS high), conversion at CSTART rising (modeled as the convst edge); leaving extended sampling (two CS falling edges with CSTART high, p.8) is not modeled
power-up initialization write A000h; the first conversion after power up or power down is invalid
result pipelining: SDO carries the previous conversion result; the result is constant
SDO goes to Hi-Z after the 16th bit (p.4): modeled as idle Hi-Z; no CS-rise-to-Hi-Z time is given (tFloat 0)

timing (p.21): tValid = td(CSL-DOV) 25 ns; tOut = td(SCLK-DOV) 0.5 SCLK + 19 ns after the SCLK rising edge at 2.7 V, i.e. 19 ns after the falling edge on which SDO changes; earlier silicon (date code before 31xxxxx, p.34) changed SDO on the rising edge
variants: TLV2544 (4 channels, 16-pin D/PW) and TLV2548 (8 channels, 20-pin DW/PW/FK) share tlv2544.pdf; tlv2548q.pdf (TLV2548Q, TLV2548M FK) and tlv2548-ep.pdf (TLV2548M-EP) have the same 20-pin numbering. Low-voltage version of the TLC2558.
